price_policy: Always use official first-party vendor standard list USD prices (current or historical official publication when retired on first-party API; never substitute third-party reseller rates or temporary promotional discounts). When cache_write has multiple TTL durations (e.g., 5m vs 1h, 30m vs 12h), select the shorter TTL. Use models.dev or LiteLLM USD reference rates only when the vendor has not published a standard USD pay-as-you-go token price; null means unknown.
review_changes: 2026-11-27: refresh catalog for active mainstream general/coding LLMs across OpenAI (GPT-5.2..6.2), Anthropic (Claude 4.5..5.5), Google Gemini (2.5..4), Alibaba Qwen (3.5..4, Coder, evergreen), DeepSeek (V3.2..V4.1), xAI Grok (4.20..4.7), Z.ai GLM (4.7..5.4), Moonshot Kimi (K2.6..K3.1), MiniMax (M2.7..M3.1), ByteDance Doubao Seed (2.0..2.1), Tencent Hunyuan (Hy4), Meta Muse, and Mistral.

2026-11-27: exclude obscure vendors (command-a-plus, mimo-*, step-*), restricted industry/whitelist SKUs (healthcare/law/cyber/rosalind/mythos), non-LLM image/audio endpoints, and retired 2024-2025 legacy models.
2026-11-27: enforce official non-promotional list USD prices, shorter cache_write TTLs (Anthropic/Kimi 5m, OpenAI 30m), and explicit Gemini thinking-intensity aliases.
